question: Which of the following element has atomic number 87?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Francium.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The element francium has the **atomic number 87** and the **symbol Fr.**
 
• It has a** high radioactivity level.**
 
• The **half-life of francium-223**, its** most stable isotope**, is barely **22 minutes.**
 
• After only caesium, it is the** second-most electropositive element.**
 
• It is the** second-rarest element** that occurs naturally.
 
• **Radium** is subjected to a **neutron bombardment **in a nuclear reactor to produce francium.
 
• It can also be made by **bombarding thorium with protons.​**
 
• **Atomic number:**
 
 
• The **quantity of protons** in an atom's nucleus is known as the atomic number.
 
• The** identification of an element **is determined by its **proton count.**
